name: Ripple Text
description: A line of text that behaves like a water surface: pressing a letter sends a wave both ways along the line, and the pointer pushes a small bow wave ahead of it.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. It stays real, selectable text laid out by the page in the inherited font; the moving letters sit exactly over it.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: Height in pixels a letter rises next to a press. The wave loses height as it spreads and with distance along the line.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for how fast the wave travels along the line.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, an inline block. Other span props are passed through. Under reduced motion the text stays still.
